site_subtitle: Prospector nested-sampling fits of the JADES DR4/DR5 sample

runs.name: fesc_ns
runs.label: fesc model
runs.description: Nested-sampling fits with the fesc (escape-fraction) model.
runs.model_description: Prospector-style "fesc" model fitted with CERIDWEN (JAX) and adaptive nested sampling (blackjax-ns), yielding the full posterior and the Bayesian evidence ln Z for per-galaxy model comparison against the extra-young variant. Physics: 8-bin continuity SFH on the extra-young age grid (bin edges 0, 3, 5, 10 Myr, then log-spaced to the age of the Universe at z = 20), BPASS 2.2 stellar populations with CLOUDY nebular emission, two-component Charlot & Fall (2000) dust with the Kriek & Conroy (2013) attenuation curve, Madau (1995) IGM absorption, and redshift sampled with a per-galaxy prior tied to the catalogue z_spec. The additional free parameter frac_obrun lets a fraction of the O/B stars run away from their birth clouds / escape, reducing the nebular line and continuum emission relative to the ionizing output. This run uses the default runaway_bc geometry, in which frac_obrun bypasses birth-cloud dust only; the picket-fence run is the alternative.
priors_table: Student-t(df = 2, loc = 0, scale = 0.5) per ratio — bursty continuity SFH
Uniform(-1.0, 0.4) — offset from Calzetti in Kriek & Conroy (2013)
flags A/B: TruncNormal(z_spec, 0.01(1+z_spec)); flag C: sigma = 0.02(1+z_spec); both on [0, 20]; no secure z_spec: Uniform(0, 20)
emission-line aperture scaling = 1; birth-cloud slope alpha = -1.3 (da Cunha+ 2008); Madau (1995) IGM

runs.name: extra_young_ns
runs.label: extra-young model
runs.description: Nested-sampling fits with the extra-young SFH model.
runs.model_description: Baseline variant of the same physical model, fitted identically with CERIDWEN (JAX) and adaptive nested sampling: 8-bin continuity SFH on the extra-young age grid (0, 3, 5, 10 Myr edges, then log-spaced to the age of the Universe at z = 20), BPASS 2.2 stellar populations with CLOUDY nebular emission, Charlot & Fall (2000) + Kriek & Conroy (2013) dust, Madau (1995) IGM, and the same per-galaxy redshift prior. It has no frac_obrun parameter (all ionizing photons are processed by the birth clouds), so the evidence difference ln Z(fesc) - ln Z(extra-young) quantifies the support for the escape/runaway channel in each galaxy.

runs.name: fesc_pc_ns
runs.label: picket-fence model
runs.description: Nested-sampling fits with the picket-fence escape model.
runs.model_description: Identical model and sampler to the fesc run (8-bin continuity SFH on the extra-young age grid, BPASS 2.2 with CLOUDY nebular emission, Charlot & Fall 2000 + Kriek & Conroy 2013 dust, Madau 1995 IGM, per-galaxy redshift prior, frac_obrun free), but run with the picket-fence escape geometry (--fesc_geometry picket): partial covering in which the escaped channel bypasses ALL dust and the nebular emission receives no bypass mix, so the escape fraction imprints on the >912 A continuum rather than only on the birth-cloud attenuation (Giovinazzo et al. 2026 geometry). The fesc run uses the default runaway_bc geometry, where frac_obrun bypasses birth-cloud dust only; comparing ln Z between the two therefore tests which escape geometry each galaxy prefers.
